name: PropReturns
long_description: PropReturns is an online platform to buy, sell and rent commercial real estate in India. The real estate market in India is highly fragmented and plagued by lack of transparency. We empower businesses and individuals in India to transact commercial real estate backed by data.
one_liner: End-to-end commercial real estate transaction platform
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Founder @ Momentary Labs, and Co-Founder @ PropReturns - India's biggest commercial real estate platform. Scaled PropReturns to $85M+ GTV, and 650,000 sqft. of transactions through the platform. 

Previously cofounded AudaceLabs and AutoChain. AudaceLabs was an AI consulting lab with enterprise clients such as Emirates Airlines, Etisalat etc; AutoChain was a used car marketplace, and was recognised by Ministry of Economy as one of the 10 most innovative startups in the UAE.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Building AI for the physical world. Named the company after an elf from LOTR. No regrets.
